name: brex
description: Connect to Brex through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Brex documents a remote MCP (beta) with OAuth and dynamic client registration ('MCP clients don't need to be pre-registered') or an admin-created API token. The beta is self-service: an admin accepts the Developer API agreement and turns on 'Brex in AI assistants' in Settings, Beta features, with no Brex approval. Brex's self-serve Essentials plan is $0 per user and includes Brex API access. Brex is a business card and spend platform, so there is no personal account. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

probe.reason: Protected resource metadata does not match the MCP endpoint
